spec.title: Context intelligence
spec.purpose: Select and maintain reviewable project context without promoting imported content to authority.

requirements.statement: Recognize conventional ADR directories and exclude documentation templates.

then: Decision files are classified as ADRs without executing code.

requirements.statement: Require pass for mandatory gates and distinguish static CI references from executed evidence.

given: A gate is missing, skipped, conditional or referenced by CI.
when: Gate evaluation or wiring inspection runs.
then: Unproven mandatory checks block and CI inspection never claims execution.

requirements.statement: Generate shared managed instruction blocks preserving user text and recovery on write failure.

given: Project rules and existing agent instruction files exist.
when: Managed blocks are built or checked.
then: External bytes are preserved, source changes detected and failed writes restored.

requirements.statement: Check local references and source drift without disclosing private file contents.

given: A project contains missing references, restricted paths or a saved snapshot.
then: Findings distinguish broken references and drift; secret files are not read as context.

requirements.statement: Select task-relevant documents with dependency closure and explicit budget overflow.

given: Documents declare scope, sources and dependencies.
when: A task requests context with a small budget.
then: Required dependencies remain present, reasons are explicit and overflow is reported.
